descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
#                                                                                                                                                                                                      
[media]

# Multiplayer Update Now Live!                              
The most requested feature in Frenzy VR history is finally here. Squad up with friends across sandbox mode or any modded map.
[media]

# Fully Interactive & Destructive Environments. 
Nothing is off limits. Tear apart everything in sight and crash out with zero real-world consequences.
[media]

# Ragdolls
Watch NPCs fly with physics-driven ragdolls that react to every hit, every time.
[media]

# Over 50 Different Weapons at Your Disposal
From melee to firearms, every weapon carries real weight and impact built for pure chaos.
[media]

# 10+ Maps, Missions & Endless Mods
Unique maps, scenarios, and enemies in every level, with community-made mods adding even more ways to play.
[media]

# Story Mode & Free Play
Take on the full campaign, or cut loose in free play and make the mayhem your own.
[media]
